2026-03-02.query:
SELECT id,time,rx_sign,rx_loc,tx_sign,tx_loc,frequency,power,snr,drift,version,code
FROM wspr.rx WHERE band=7 AND toDate(time,'UTC')=toDate('2026-03-02') AND cityHash64(id)%128=0
ORDER BY time,id LIMIT 50001 FORMAT JSONEachRow
